title: Extraction provider error record
description: The terminal-failure companion to extraction_run@0.1.0 (ADR-034). extraction_run is strict and released and carries status and error_count but no error_reason, so an errored run alone would lose the terminal cause. That contract is not widened; the reason is bound here instead and pins the four artifacts of the failed run by reference and SHA-256. There is no free-text property anywhere in this schema, so an upstream exception message, response body, header, token, or credential has no channel into the record — a structural guarantee rather than a redaction pass. This record is written only when at least one provider attempt began; live_call_not_authorized is a pre-run refusal that produces no artifact at all and never appears in reason_code.

code_commit.comment: Caller-injected. This package reads no VCS.

reason_code.comment: Closed enum. live_call_not_authorized is deliberately absent: it is refused before any attempt begins.

attempt_count.comment: Equals extraction_run.error_count: the number of failed provider attempts.
